column1: # The phase doc's Why-lines table (phase-12-setup-wizard.md, Decisions T12-4), parsed from the doc, never from the app.

column2: Start opens when you press Home. Without it Home goes to another launcher.
Live tiles and unread counts come from your notifications. Without it the tiles stay still.
The Photos tile shows your pictures. Without it the tile stays empty.
Music plays the songs on this phone. Without it Music finds nothing to play.
The Calendar tile shows what's next. Without it the tile stays empty.
Weather shows the weather where you are. Without it Weather cannot tell where that is.
Back on Start returns to the app you were using. Without it Back stays on Start.
This turns on the Windows-style keyboard. Without it the keyboard cannot be chosen.
This makes it the keyboard wherever you type. Without it your old keyboard stays.
People shows and edits your contacts. Without it People can't see them.
Alarms ring over the lock screen. Without it an alarm still sounds, but shows only as a notification.
Alarms ring over the app you're using. Without it an alarm shows as a notification.
The side key and the assist gesture open Tess. Without it they open another assistant.
Tess hears what you ask. Without it you can only type to her.
Tess calls and texts people by name. Without it she cannot find them.
Tess reads your calendar and adds to it. Without it she cannot see or add events.
Tess sends a text after reading it back to you. Without it she cannot send one.
Tess places a call after you confirm. Without it she cannot call.
Place reminders go off when you arrive. Without "all the time" they never fire.
Person reminders go off after you talk to that person. Without it they cannot tell you did.
Person reminders go off after you text that person. Without it they cannot tell you did.
